dedupe_keys.name: lithuania eso electricity and gas distribution network map services on geoportal lt lines of all voltages substations gas pipelines and fittings

description: The Lithuanian spatial information portal geoportal.lt publishes two ArcGIS view services from Energijos skirstymo operatorius (ESO), the national electricity and gas distribution system operator. Contents: the electricity service (ESO_DB_Public) shows overhead lines and cables of all voltages (0.4 kV, 6 to 10 kV and 35 kV), 110 and 35 kV substations, transformer substations and distribution cabinets, planned network elements (cables, substations and cabinets under design), radio relay towers and communication cables; the gas service (ESO_DUJOS_Public) has 39 layers covering distribution pipelines and disused pipelines, pressure regulating installations, shut-off valves, condensate collectors, manholes, protective casings and the cathodic corrosion protection system (anodes, cathodic protection units, test posts). Producer: ESO, with the portal run by the Construction Sector Development Agency. Coverage: the ESO service territory, which is nearly all of Lithuania. Format and access: ArcGIS MapServer view services proxied by geoportal.lt; the metadata states the electricity data are refreshed weekly, overnight from Wednesday to Thursday; the map layers can be viewed and displayed in GIS software, but feature queries and downloads are switched off at the proxy. Licence: displayed under ESO and portal copyright; no open licence is stated. Caveats: view only, so vector geometry and attributes cannot be extracted without a data request to ESO; the transmission grid (Litgrid) and gas transmission (Amber Grid) are not included. Simulation uses: checking distribution network layouts for resilience and hazard studies, siting and connection analysis, and gas network corrosion protection context. Related records: the RRT mobile coverage and fixed network development data (data-rrt-lithuania-mobile-coverage-and-fixed-network-development) cover Lithuanian telecom networks.
